MuJoCo 3.14.0, Google DeepMind. Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE.txt.
Upstream: https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco
Source commit: 9ecbb9d7b5ee623f54745638d36799ff90e6f7cd

This is a project-specific compilation, not an unmodified npm distribution.
Emscripten 4.0.10, Release -O3, -msimd128, -ffp-contract=off, single threaded.
No fast-math or relaxed-SIMD arithmetic. Upstream assertion and exception
handling settings remain enabled. No MuJoCo physics source was changed.
Debug/source-map output was removed from wasm/CMakeLists.txt to permit the
normal post-link optimizations; source paths in diagnostics are normalized.

Rebuild: scripts/build_mujoco_simd.py in the Drosophila Critic repository.
Qualification: tests/body-physics.test.mjs, scripts/check_body_physics.mjs,
docs/BODY-SPEED.md and experiments/body-speed-v1/.
The original official binary in vendor/mujoco remains the numerical reference.
